document_title: Entry on Rehearing (denying the applications for rehearing of the Data Center Coalition, The Ohio Blockchain Council, Ohio Manufacturers' Association Energy Group, One Power Company, and Amazon Data Services, Inc.)
how_obtained: Fetched the PDF over HTTPS from the Supreme Court of Ohio public docket document handler (pdf_viewer.aspx), then extracted the embedded text layer with PyMuPDF 1.26.5 page.get_text("text"), concatenating pages in order. No cleaning, reflowing, de-hyphenation, encoding repair or page markers were applied; marginal line numbers, running heads, Q/A markers and blank image-only (redacted) pages appear exactly as the extractor produced them. Entered in the Journal September 3, 2025. The rehearing counterpart of the July 9, 2025 Opinion and Order in the same docket.
